correctness.rationale: Every proper subgroup of a nonabelian order-p-cubed group is abelian, and its center equals commutator of order p. A surjective finite-input homomorphism must therefore contain a unique automorphism coordinate; remaining commuting-coordinate images lie in the center and kill the commutator. Centered iterates act as alpha on central fibers and bar-alpha on the quotient. At t=ord(alpha), the quotient is fixed and the central-fiber action is identity, so H^t is a quotient-dependent central translation; its pth power is identity. Thus the global bi-infinite identity F^(pt)=sigma^(kpt) and its entropy, mixing, equicontinuity and exact rule count follow. Independent finite enumeration on four groups agrees with all checked claims, without being substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This is a uniform structural, exact-iterate, entropy and local-rule-count classification of surjective dynamics for all nonabelian order-p-cubed alphabets. It includes the two nonabelian p3 groups for every odd prime not treated by Q8-only prior classifications and gives a sharp necessary central exponent factor; it goes beyond per-rule decidability and table recomputation.
